integration: Crew Mesh supervised sub-agent spawning and event forwarding

sourceFilesAdapted.changes: Adapted supervisor multi-target handoffs, per-target error isolation, shared batch identity, result-order preservation, agent-path metadata, and concise supervisor guidelines to SelfImpulse's existing runSubAgent boundary and Captain prompt. Added a bound of three concurrent workers and four jobs per call instead of importing the upstream Agent, provider, registry, telemetry, or AI SDK stack.
Adapted forwarded-event filtering and sub-agent metadata enrichment to the existing persisted SubAgentRun IPC events. No ReadableStream or AI SDK event types are required.

mergedFeatures: one supervisor call can spawn a named team of up to four specialists
bounded parallel execution with independent per-agent outcomes
deterministic job lineage for durable replay
purpose, agent-path, batch, usage, and lifecycle metadata in existing Crew runs
real tool and lifecycle event forwarding through the existing subagent IPC channel
excluded: the full @voltagent/core npm package and its provider/OpenTelemetry dependencies
upstream Agent registry, memory, guardrails, MCP, server, and observability platform
nested delegation that could bypass SelfImpulse's Crew no-prompt boundary
a second provider loop, tool runtime, persistence layer, or dashboard
authority: SelfImpulse AgentRuntime, governance, DLP, approvals, durable journal, provider adapter, and SubAgentService remain authoritative.
